newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Minister without portfolio Ma Ying-jeou resigns.
Some National Assembly members sign petition requiring resignation of President Lee Teng-hui.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Ma Ying-jeou leaves politics.
At least 40 die in plane crash in China's southern Shenzhen city.
LIBERTY TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party expected to garner enough majority to turn back opposition motion in parliament demanding cabinet reshuffle.
Ruling Nationalist Party disappointed by Ma's resignation.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Three cabinet-level officials resign; new faces expected in reshuffled cabinet.
Central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong says bank will launch mild mop-up measures if liquidity in banking system becomes too loose.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Monetary policy to remain stable-to-loose, but not too loose.
Sheu Yuan-dong says political changes have not affected financial markets.
